preamble: Hardening of the voiced alveolo-palatal fricative [ʑ] to the voiced retroflex fricative [ʐ]. The clearest documented case is Russian, where the marginal long soft [ʑː] of words like дрожжи 'yeast', вожжи 'reins', позже 'later' and езжу 'I ride' is increasingly replaced by hard [ʐː]; the soft pronunciation survives mainly in the conservative Moscow standard.

examples.note: Both pronunciations are current; the hard [ʐː] replaces the conservative Moscow soft [ʑː].
Same replacement of soft [ʑː] by hard [ʐː] in the plural of вожжа.
Comparative of поздно; the hard variant follows the general loss of soft [ʑː].
First-person singular of ездить, with the same soft ~ hard variation.
